question: Top 3 de sponsors de la industria por cantidad de ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados) en cáncer de pulmón, considerando solo el sponsor principal.

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN aact.sponsors sp ON sp.nct_id = s.nct_id AND sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' AND sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms')
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
